rules.reason: Blocked: this drives the user's real screen. Use `ade screen` (the lane's own screen), `ade app-control` (a dev Electron app) or `ade browser`. See the ade-computer-use skill.
Use `ade prs create --lane <lane>` so ADE links the PR to this chat. If the user asked for gh by name, run the same command again and it will go through.
Use `ade prs body <pr> --body-file <file>`. If the user asked for gh by name, run the same command again and it will go through.
